bullets.text: T-Mobile's Legal Troubles Grow - **Verizon** challenges T-Mobile's switching strategy, alleging misleading savings claims and deceptive practices.
AT&T Partners with Amazon - **AT&T** integrates **Amazon Leo** satellite services with its fiber network to enhance connectivity.
Open RAN Myths Debunked - **Wind River** asserts that **Open RAN** technology is now mature and scalable for all environments.
Bell's AI Revenue Surge - **Bell Canada** reports a 60% year-over-year growth in its AI-powered enterprise solutions.
5G Slicing Validated - **Ericsson**, **FET**, and **OPPO** confirm performance-based 5G slicing can enhance connectivity.
Amazon's Leo Launch Delays - **Amazon** requests an extension for its **Leo** satellite launch, citing unavoidable issues.
Quantum Security Concerns - Experts warn of impending quantum technology threats to current encryption methods by the 2030s.
Verizon's AI Infrastructure Strategy - **Verizon** outlines plans to leverage metro fiber and private 5G for enterprise AI workloads.
Network Digital Twins for Telecom - New software technology provides real-time visibility and predictive analytics for telecom networks.
AT&T Expands Fiber Network - **AT&T** completes acquisition of **Lumen's** fiber business, enhancing its service footprint.
